name: Seolleongtang or Samgyetang (Korean Bone Broth Soup)
whyItWorks: Korean ox-bone soup is simmered for 12+ hours until pure collagen and protein, served with soft white rice and thin beef slices - zero spice, zero fiber, pure gut healing.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Season with sea salt at the table to taste. Skip the radish/cabbage kimchi and raw chopped green onions.
